meta.note: US installed costs before incentives (i.e., before the federal residential clean energy credit, which the One Big Beautiful Bill Act eliminated for battery/solar installations placed in service in 2026). Fields marked as estimates in a preset's `estimatedFields` array are not manufacturer-disclosed figures; treat them as directional, not specification-grade.
meta.priceVolatilityNote: Installed costs for batteries and solar vary substantially by installer, region, and system size; installedCostUSD and costPerWattInstalled are representative point estimates within the cited ranges, not quotes.

batteries.label: Tesla Powerwall 3
batteries.notes: 11.5 kW continuous on-grid (15.4 kW peak off-grid) per EnergySage/manufacturer spec; installedCostUSD is the midpoint of the $13,000-$16,500 2026 installed-price range reported across sources. Tesla's warranty is unlimited-cycle / time-and-capacity based (10 years, >=70% capacity retention), not a stated cycle-count limit; cycleLife of 6,000 is a representative LFP cell figure used for modeling, not a Tesla-published number.

batteries.label: Enphase IQ Battery 5P
batteries.notes: 3.84 kW continuous (7.68 kW peak for 3s, 6.14 kW for 10s), 100% depth of discharge, 15-year/6,000-cycle limited warranty per Enphase datasheet. roundTripEff of 96% is Enphase's stated DC round-trip figure; AC round-trip (including the built-in microinverters) is reported closer to 90% in some reviews. installedCostUSD ($7,000) sits within the widely reported $5,000-$8,000 per-unit range (~$1,000-1,600/kWh usable).

batteries.label: FranklinWH aPower 2
batteries.notes: 10 kW continuous (15 kW surge), inverter-agnostic via the aGate hub, 12-year warranty per manufacturer/review specs. installedCostUSD is the midpoint of the reported $1,100-$1,200/kWh ($16,500-$18,000 per unit) range. Exact cycle-life was not found in a manufacturer datasheet during this pass; 6,000 is a representative LFP figure, flagged as estimated.

batteries.label: UNIGRID Na+Casa (sodium-ion)
batteries.notes: First-generation residential sodium-ion product (NCO sodium-ion chemistry), shipping in Europe as of July 2026 with US installations targeted for late 2026 pending UL 9540 certification -- as of this writing it is not yet a purchasable US-installed product, so installedCostUSD is not a real quote. Manufacturer-disclosed: 9.25 kWh usable, 10,000 cycles at 100% depth of discharge, 25-year design life/warranty, -40F to 140F operating range. roundTripEff, max charge/discharge power, and installedCostUSD were not disclosed by the manufacturer; the values here are estimates (roundTripEff scaled down from LFP's ~96% to reflect sodium-ion's typically lower reported round-trip efficiency; charge/discharge power scaled from comparable ~9-10kWh LFP units' roughly 0.5C rating; installedCostUSD extrapolated from the manufacturer's claim of pricing 'competitively with lithium-ion' applied to comparable small-format LFP $/kWh installed costs). A different sodium-ion entrant, Natron Energy, was considered but is excluded: it shut down operations in September 2025 (assignment for the benefit of creditors) and has no current product to price.

LFP.note: Representative of modern LFP home-battery products (Powerwall 3, Enphase 5P, FranklinWH aPower 2 above); used as fallback defaults when no specific preset is selected.

NMC.note: NMC home batteries (e.g., older Powerwall 2, LG RESU) are typically specified to a shallower recommended depth of discharge and shorter cycle/calendar life than LFP, per widely reported industry comparisons; no single current product was used to derive these figures, so treat as directional.

Na-ion.note: Blends the UNIGRID Na+Casa preset above with more conservative published cycle-life claims (8,000-10,000 cycles) from sodium-ion cell/pack makers reporting on residential-scale applications; the category is early enough that a single product should not be treated as fully representative.

costPerWattInstalled.note: Roughly the midpoint between EnergySage's marketplace average ($2.58-$2.60/W in early 2026, a competitive online-quote sample) and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory's Tracking the Sun median cash price for residential PV ($3.50/W, 2024 data, the broader real-world figure including non-competitive/single-quote installs). Before any incentives.

String inverters are commonly cited as needing replacement within a 10-15 year window (this preset's defaultYear of 12 sits mid-range); $0.30/W is a representative planning figure for the replacement itself, not a competitive-quote figure the way costPerWattInstalled above is -- installed string-inverter replacement quotes for a typical residential system size were found spanning roughly $0.15-0.60/W depending on system size and labor, with sources in the $0.25-0.35/W band for a mid-size (6-10 kW) system most consistent with this figure. No single manufacturer-disclosed or EnergySage-marketplace-quality figure was found for this line item specifically; treat as directional, like this file's other estimatedFields.

costPerKWInstalled.note: Median installed cost for small wind (residential-scale, <100 kW) per NREL's Distributed Wind Market Report, cited at ~$8,000/kW with a broader ~$4,000-$12,000/kW range depending on tower height, site complexity, and system size.
